title: Population risk falls by selection
hook: Two stated cases: explore the changing composition of surviving risk groups.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the changing composition of surviving risk groups affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Hazard, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the changing composition of surviving risk groups in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
